# Bima Sekti (opswithbima)

> Inventory and supply chain specialist based in Jakarta, Indonesia (GMT+7), working remotely worldwide. 9 years of experience, including 4.5 years in materials and order management at Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE). Helps growing businesses stop stockouts, fix inventory data and cut procurement waste.

## Verified work results
- Hewlett Packard Enterprise (2019–2023), Material & Order Management Specialist: recovered $90,000 in working capital by cutting pending part returns from $150K to $60K; reduced procurement lead times by 25%, production delays by 20% and excess raw material stock by 25%; 30% faster PO processing at 99.8% accuracy; 660+ SAP lines a month. SAP SD/MM, Power BI.
- Suryanesia (2024–2025), Procurement & Logistics Specialist: procurement and logistics for 23 commercial & industrial rooftop solar projects (27 MWp), including 43,000+ panels, 210 inverters and 70+ import containers; 11% saving on mounting structures; 99.7% warehouse stock accuracy.
- Sleep EZ Australia (2025–2026), Inventory & Supply Chain Specialist: Amazon FBA inventory for 3 brands and 39 SKUs in Australia; no stockouts through Chinese New Year factory shutdowns.
- Yusen Logistics (2018–2019), Traffic Planner: dispatched 20 container trucks a day between Tanjung Priok Port and factories; recruited directly by HPE.
- DHL Supply Chain (2017–2018), Inventory Analyst: 99.5%+ inventory accuracy for the Unilever account (500+ SKUs), leading a shift team of 2 checkers.

## Services
- Inventory Health Check: SKU risk list, reorder points, safety stock, data error review.
- Operations Dashboard Build: Excel or Power BI dashboards for inventory, purchasing and supplier KPIs.
- Procurement & Supplier Review: spend analysis, supplier OTIF scorecards, consolidation plan.
- Also open to roles: Inventory Analyst, Supply/Demand Planner, Procurement Specialist.
